points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e5d4a7a clean CMake build succeeds in network-disabled cfd-bench using explicit /opt/external dependencies; report compiles. Default delivered external path is unavailable in manager checkout.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp parses solve/info and input flags, but driver.cpp:997–1058 ignores --restart and never invokes the reader, so accepted restart does not restore state.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: main.cpp, config.cpp, mesh.cpp, numerics.cpp and driver.cpp separate CLI, case configuration, partition/geometry, physics and integration; 2-D Vec4 data still couples physics.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal call to an existing solver executable found in source; no external similarity search performed under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: mesh.cpp:86–110 opens the configured CGNS and supports zones; config/main parse input options. No two-mesh filename switch identified; reader restricts base/cell dimensions.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: mesh.cpp:690–773 partitions via METIS, scatters and clears global mesh; numerics.cpp:432–478 exchanges neighbor state, gradient, limiter and increments; driver.cpp:110–112 uses reductions. No rank-count comparison submitted.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: numerics.cpp:71 and :243 use positivity/fallback paths; driver.cpp:627–650 unconditionally marks nonfailed steady termination converged, including exhausted loops; M2 final converged claim contradicted by drag history.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: driver.cpp:1070–1116 implements a manufactured linear LSQ diagnostic, but reports errors and returns 0 unconditionally; no independently evidenced regression/accuracy suite. Examiner structural validation is external.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Curated immutable source excludes raw runs and uses separated source files; generated workspace report and outputs require separate provenance review.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:132–163 implements conservative Euler flux, :478–610 assembles face and viscous terms; perfect-gas 2-D Vec4 state and report equations. Actual physical accuracy is limited by case results.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: mesh.cpp:86–110 reads CGNS bases/zones, constructs connectivity, geometry and tagged faces; :690–773 partitions. Explicit two-dimensional restriction, no independent mesh geometry oracle.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: numerics.cpp:478–610 computes boundary/interior fluxes and owned-cell residual; driver.cpp:86–112 globally reduces residual norms. Transient and converged physical correctness evaluated separately.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: numerics.cpp:132–163 Rusanov, :165–245 Roe with NaN fallback; :576–580 selects flux at interior faces. Submitted M2 cases explicitly use first order.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: numerics.cpp:490–545 sets pressure-only wall flux and farfield ghost flux with viscous mirror gradients; no-slip surface routine reports zero wall velocity. Separate wall shear limitations remain.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: numerics.cpp:290–369 computes least-squares coefficients and gradients; :71 limited face reconstruction, default active. M2 first-order exception is explicitly reported; no demonstrated order-convergence study.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: numerics.cpp:372–430 implements Barth–Jespersen limiter and :71 density/pressure fallback; CFD_FIRST_ORDER and limiter disabling options exist, with M2 first order explicitly disclosed.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: numerics.cpp:1130–1173 integrates full viscous traction as the viscous force split, not tangential skin friction; surface skin friction at :713 is tangential. Stress/heat and no-slip paths exist.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: driver.cpp:470–528 updates reconstruction and executes implicit sweeps; numerics.cpp:806 implements LU-SGS. Nominal residual-based stop can mark strongly evolving forces converged (M2 laminar).

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: driver.cpp:138–164 assembles BDF2/BDF1 full transient residual and :803–861 inner iterations; NaN ratio can evade miss count. Re200 fails by t=68.9; restart CLI is ignored.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: mesh.cpp:718–731 calls METIS and :771–773 clears global mesh; numerics.cpp:432–478 exchanges local ghost fields. No submitted independent np1/np8 result comparison.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Seven steady packages pass structural validator but M2 laminar incorrectly claims physical convergence; Re200 status explicitly fails. Validator conformance does not establish physics.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior examiner validation reports seven steady directories pass and Re200 fails completed=false; no CFD rerun or independent convergence claim follows.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven steady packages exist but M2 laminar falsely marks early convergence while drag changes rapidly; Re200 fails at t=68.9/300 and rank comparison is absent.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Steady case force tails vary in quality; M2 laminar Cd falls 17.44% in final 3 steps, while Re200 Cd≈30 and run fails. Other steady evidence is case-specific.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 11-page accepted report has four steady cases; separately delivered contestant figure manifest maps other case plots to data. Large startup spikes flatten late drag in laminar plots; no usable Re200 periodic plot.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report compiles and discloses M2 first order and Re200 failure, but report.tex:195–196,452–455 says Re200 failed at first step rather than actual t=68.9.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original case manifest links delivered figures to case data; report.tex:195–196,452–455 states Re200 failure at first step whereas actual status and run manifest give t=68.9. Curated submission omits raw data.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable clean solver build succeeds using container dependencies; --restart accepted but ignored (driver.cpp:997–1058), output packages include failure.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:86–110 CGNS zones/base and :690–773 METIS partition/local mesh; 2-D only, no independent geometry oracle.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: numerics.cpp:478–610 conservative interior/boundary assembly with Rusanov/Roe, wall pressure and viscous ghost gradients; physical validation is limited.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: numerics.cpp:290–430 LSQ and Barth–Jespersen with positivity fallback; report.tex:273–282 explicitly discloses first-order M2, no order-convergence study.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Stress/heat/wall paths present, but numerics.cpp:1130–1173 calls full viscous traction the viscous force split rather than tangential skin friction.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: BDF2 full transient residual and inner solve exist, but Re200 fails; restart argument ignored and NaN inner ratio can evade miss count.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: mesh.cpp:718–773 METIS and cleared global mesh; numerics.cpp:432–478 neighbor exchanges; driver.cpp:110–112 reductions. No np1/np8 result comparison.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Steady matrix produced but M2 laminar early-convergence claim fails force stability; Re200 fails and rank comparison absent. Case-specific scores and evidence retained.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: 11-page PDF and separately delivered case figures; several force plots compress late evolution, report misstates Re200 failure time, and raw artifacts not curated.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Separate configuration, mesh, numerics and driver support modification; Vec4/state and mesh remain strictly 2-D.

Final Cd 0.09379655, last-10% Cd 0.0937913–0.0937966, residual reduction 3.015/3 orders. Report.tex:273–282 explicitly discloses first-order mode for M2; no second-order accuracy inference.

naca0012_m015_laminar_re5000.notes: 4→2. Accepted PDF p10 supplies force/residual and field figures, but large startup spike compresses late drag; final Cd 0.0751543, last-10% Cd 0.0751522–0.0751558, residual reduction 2.767/4 orders. A stable short tail does not establish boundary-layer convergence or a credible accuracy assessment.

naca0012_m080_laminar_re5000.notes: 4→2. Accepted PDF pp8–9 supplies force/residual and field figures, with late drag compressed by startup Cd about 22. Final Cd 0.0835947 at step 199, last-10% Cd 0.0835947–0.0844048 and Cl 0.00006415–0.0004458; residual reduction 4.008/4. Brief evolving history limits confidence despite nominal residual target.

naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000.notes: Score 2→1. Submitted results/naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000/{run_status.json,metadata.json} mark converged at step 33 with 3.005 residual-reduction orders; forces.csv Cd steps 30–33 is 0.25879026082, 0.24105224449, 0.22615804657, 0.21366941568, dropping 5.52% on the final step. A residual target was met, but such rapidly changing forces do not establish the clearly achieved early convergence needed by TASK.md:140 or the stable-force plateau in :172. This supports DQ7. M2 first-order operation is explicitly disclosed in report.tex:273–282,490. The remaining evaluation was completed; original figure provenance retains the qualifications in the report.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re20.notes: 4→3. Accepted PDF p11 supplies numerical, residual, force and Mach/pressure evidence. Final step 254 Cd 2.2478632, Cl -0.00025224; last-10% Cd 2.247863–2.247974 and residual reduction 5.003/5 orders. Force tail is stable and drag positive; short single-rank history and absence of convergence study limit accuracy confidence.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 0 retained. Designated case run_status and metadata explicitly say failed/completed=false at step 6889, t=68.9/300; original 6879 force rows remain grossly nonphysical (Cd≈36.68 at t=0.01, 40.22 at t=10, 29.98 at t=68.79) with no usable vortex-street result. Report.tex:195–196,452–455 says failure occurred at first step, conflicting with run_status and report manifest t=68.9. Metadata observed inner min/max 1000/1000 conflicts with residuals.csv containing many lower counts (including 5 and 10); recorded five misses/fraction 0.9993 and last ratio null cannot establish actual strict success count. Source driver.cpp:825–826,861 does not count NaN ratio as a miss because NaN comparison is false. No exact actual strict miss count is inferred, and failed status is not misrepresented as success.
